strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Doctor Cliff, Izu has cleared us for landing.
It is, but the situation remains uncertain.
Good grief... What with the <Fabula Foresse> incident@and the <Cross Gate Burst>,@that peace sure didn't last.
...Hey, will there be another war like last time?
If it comes to that, I will fight.
No, I'm the only one who needs to.
You told me... you wanted to try living a different life.
That's true, but if you're going to fight...
Only my machine got clearance for use.@You two don't need to fight.
If it's the <Sympathia> you're worried about,@we can just switch it off.
That's not the point.@If something happened to you, what about <Chris>?@Where would she come back to?
(Besides, Raki doesn't have much time left...)
But the risk is the same for you too, Bro.
Even I didn't expect the seal on the Geant Chevalier@to be lifted this soon.
But after what happened@with the <Fabula Foresse>...
When the Cross Gate, the root of it all, pulls@something like that right over our heads,@even the Federation Army changes its mind.
If the army saw us as dangerous, we couldn't@be together like this. We couldn't even have gone@back to Antarctica after <The Sealing War>.
Josh is right. Without you two, we couldn't@have defeated <Ruina> and <Perfectio>.@The Federation Army understands that too.
Besides, with the <Steel Dragons> around,@you won't need to fight anymore.
Beginning landing approach.@Please take your seats and fasten your seat belts.
Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
The purged legs aren't badly damaged. The question@is how long it'll take to reconnect them and tune@the servo motors and synchronizers.
Then please start working on it right away.
Hold on.@I've got other urgent jobs to take care of.
Those people from before might show up again.@When they do, the more units that can sortie,@the better, right?
That's true, but we're short-handed right now...
I'll handle reconnecting the legs, at least.
Jinpu Kawanishi.@I'm in charge of developing and maintaining@the <Mighty Walker>.
Humanoid machines are basically all the same at heart.@They're modeled on people, after all. My know-how@works on other companies' products to an extent.
As an engineer, you're interested@in an <Ashurey Kreuzer> machine?
That ain't all.@One of those three girls is gonna@be riding in Bellzelute, right?
Then I wanna keep the unit maintained@so she can make it back in one piece.
Is that a roundabout way of criticizing me?
You're saying you pity Tenia and the others, right?@But you've accepted those two fighting@in the Soul Saber yourself.
I ain't exactly cheering for it.@Even now, I don't want 'em doing anything@more than test piloting.
Then you shouldn't develop weapons in the first place.
Sure, if nobody was attacking Earth.@But guys like the <Einst>, <Shura> and <Ruina>@don't give a damn about what suits us.
These days, without power, you might as well sit@and wait to die. So the boss and I decided to do@what we could, so humanity on Earth can survive.
Yeah. It's true we make a business of it.@Otherwise, we couldn't have built the Mighty Walker.@That's why I got what I deserved.
However it happened, I ended up sending two kids@who are practically my own children@off to the battlefield.
...Just so you know,@I'm not letting Tenia and Melua ride@in Bellzelute because I enjoy it.
That thing is my link to my enemy, my lead,@and it won't move without those girls. I know full@well I'm using kids for my own ends...
But I can't be picky about how I take them down.
I ain't gonna butt into your business.@I just wanna do what I can.
Not just the Soul Saber.@So Bellzelute and Granteed@can come back safe too.
...I'll leave the repairs to you.@That all right, Dr. Omiya?
Then I'll get right on it.
Thanks for coming all the way from Antarctica, Josh.
Not at all. My unit is special.@Coming to pick it up in person saves@time and trouble in the end.
We've unsealed the Aile Chevalier and the <Geant Aile>,@docked them together, and left them in the hangar.
They haven't been sealed for long,@so they should run fine after a standard check.
I'm sorry, but the transport you came on@has been reassigned to another mission at once.@It's an emergency.
Which means...@we fly the Geant Chevalier to Antarctica...?
The <Geant Aile> has a cockpit too,@but with four people aboard, it'd be tight.
Yeah... Bro and Raki might be fine, but...
Not to worry. I've put in a request with@<L&E Corporation>. The Excellence Rescue@will accompany you to Antarctica.
That's a big help. That unit has a cabin.
They're scheduled to arrive at Izu tomorrow at 1030.
Doctor Cliff,@I'd like to interview you directly later@about the <Fabula Foresse> incident.
...Josh, what are those units over there?
No idea.@A <Super Robot>... and a <Personal Trooper>?
The small one is Bellzelute...@a humanoid mobile weapon from a manufacturer@called <Ashurey Kreuzer>.
The big one is Granteed... origin unknown.@We suspect it's not a machine from Earth.
You mean it's an alien machine?
Granteed's frame structure and joint drive@methods and such resemble those of Earth's@humanoid mobile weapons...
But its engine and man-machine interface@use unknown technology,@so there's a lot we don't know.
What's more, the markings and the language@displayed inside the cockpit don't seem@to be from Earth.
And I believe Bellzelute was built on Earth@using Granteed as a reference.
A humanoid weapon built with an unknown engine@and interface... It's similar in concept@to the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige.
No, it goes well beyond that.
If you've got time,@I'd like you lot to take a look at Granteed later.
But how did such a mysterious machine@end up here...?
The boy in front of Granteed... Touya Shiun.@His father entrusted it to him,@and it was later brought to Izu Base.
Him...? He's a civilian, isn't he?
What about his father? Who is he?
An Earthling registered with the Federation@government... Seldoa Shiun.@A staff member at <Ashurey Kreuzer>.
However, given that he was piloting Granteed,@whose origin is unknown, it's doubtful@whether that's true.
Not that we can look into it.@Ashurey Kreuzer on the moon was attacked@and wiped out by an unidentified enemy...
And then Seldoa died too.@His son Touya was entrusted with Granteed, but@knows next to nothing about the circumstances.
Did he... get in Granteed of his own will?
Yes, in a situation where he had no choice but to fight.@We bear some of the blame for that, though...
(Touya Shiun, huh?@His circumstances... are like mine.)
What's wrong, Raki?@You've been staring at Granteed this whole time.@Is something bothering you?
Gravity quake reading overhead intensifying!@40 seconds until projected warp-in!
To think they'd attack again so soon...!@And with our anti-air weapons out of action.
If that's what they're aiming for,@the enemy's forces may be thicker than we thought.
Is the enemy's target Granteed again?
(If so, there are ways to hold them off...@But if their aim is to wipe out this base,@we have next to no means of stopping it.)
How much longer until the Steel Dragons get back?
Launch every unit that can sortie.@Hold out no matter what until the Steel Dragons arrive.
The target is a Zeranio-class Carrier!
Heh, it's precisely because the base's defenses@are thin that we can pull a forceful move like this.@Launch the mobile units.
(Again, they didn't open with a decisive blow.)
The enemies are all Zovorg units!
So they're different from the last bunch...?!
Hm? The Soul Saber and Bellzelute@are out, and even Granteed!
Get back, Touya Shiun!@The enemy may be after Granteed!
Then I'll be a decoy and lure them away from the base.
We were ordered to launch every unit that could sortie.
(The chance of the <Thorn> showing up again@isn't zero, after all.)
We'll provide support from the rear@until the Steel Dragons get back!
Don't be absurd...!@Major Gilliam, why did you let them sortie?
My apologies. I did try to stop them...
It's fine. It pains me, but we'll borrow their strength.@Right now, the gap between our forces is too great.
However, if the enemy is after Granteed@this time as well,@pull them back immediately.
Yeah, it's not that different@from riding in Bellzelute.
Yes... It actually seems easier@to handle than Bellzelute.
...He's become more positive.@Though he might just be forcing himself.
I think Touya will be fine.
I'm fine too.@We decided we'd all work together.
The system seems to work the same way@as Granteed's, so I can manage.
Also, the Orgone Extractor's maximum output@is higher than during our last sortie.
...Those repairs shouldn't have@touched the Extractor, though.
I don't know why, but@the Orgone Rifle Absolute@is now usable.
(Could it be Katia's doing...?@Is that even possible?)
No need to worry.@We decided we'd all work together.
Calvina, the Orgone Extractor's@maximum output is higher than before.
I dunno why, but@we can use the Orgone Rifle Absolute now.
(Could it be Tenia's doing...?@Is that even possible?)
So will I.@We decided we'd all work together.
Also, there's something I'd like to report.@Is that okay?
The Orgone Extractor's maximum output@is higher than during our last sortie.
I don't know why, but@the Orgone Rifle Absolute@has become usable.
(Could it be Melua's doing...?@Is that even possible?)
First, crush their chain of command.@All the better if the traitor dies with it.
The Geant Chevalier will hold the enemy ship.@Major Gilliam, you and the others take the rest.
Roger. Thank you for your help.
(In this situation, I have no choice@but to use the <Sympathia>.)
Something's coming from that large unit...
What do you mean? Is something malfunctioning?
Something's coming from that big guy...
Something's coming from that big unit...
(Questions can wait. I'll stop the Zeranio-class!)
So he'll be a wall, eh?@Fine. Our top priority is retaking Ariard.
Vanguard units, infiltrate the underground hangar!@This ship and the rear units will cover you!
(The enemy's movements... They're not after Granteed?@They aren't dealing the base a fatal blow either.@What they're after is...)
(Could it be the underground hangar... the Drift Wing?)
Tch, why are you struggling against so few enemies?!@At this rate...
Lord Bilgo,@a high-speed flying object is approaching! Just one!
It's not a mobile weapon! It's battleship-class!
Those bastards, how dare they hit our home turf!
Eleve 1 to all units!@Spread out and destroy the remaining enemies!
Th-This will earn me a reprimand from Lady Reggiane...!@No, actually, that would be...
...Enough. The operation has failed. Warp out.
The enemy ship has space-warped away!
Destroy the remaining enemy units at once.
All enemy reactions in the area have vanished.
All engines stop.@Maintain <TD Hovering> at current altitude@and keep a strict all-around watch.
To think they were hiding something like that here...!
With this Geant Chevalier,@even a Zeranio-class is no match!
I decided to fight on my own, but that size...!
A Zeranio-class... They're even sending that in?!
What a flimsy unit. Shoot it down already!
He's getting in my way again?!
We're way faster than they are!@No way am I backing down!
If I pick off the cannons pointing down,@we might just manage...!
Josh,@so you were the ones protecting Izu Base.
We just happened to be here right after@the Geant Chevalier's seal was lifted.
Have Rim and Glacies been well too?
Heh, what an answer. That's so like you.
You're... Touya Shiun, right?@I'm Joshua Radcliffe.@You can call me Josh.
How do you know who I am?
Major Gilliam told me about you.@And I know what you want to ask me.
When I activated the Geant Chevalier's <Sympathia>...@its man-machine interface, there was@a reaction similar to resonance.
The same thing happened@with your Granteed, right?
Y-Yes, but what do you mean, resonance...
Yes. Resonance phenomena between Sympathia units@were also confirmed during the Sealing War.@...Do you remember, Glacies?
Yes... That was what brought me here.
So they were similar after all?
Yes. After comparing the telemeter records...
We arrived at the hypothesis that the Sympathia@might be a simplified version of Granteed's@Cytron System.
It means the original Sympathia@may have been the Cytron System.
During the battle just now, was there any change@in Sleeping Beauty's condition?
No. I was monitoring her the whole time,@and there was no sign of her waking.
Major, do you believe the enemy's goal@was to retake her and the Drift Wing?
Working under you, Major, I can infer that much.@Just in case, will you confirm it@with Envoy Mekibos Borquede?
I heard earlier... the Hiryu Custom will soon@be returning from Rabulpaila.
Yes. I hope the information they've gained@will clear up my doubts...
